entries.text: Fixed DataFrame Write Primitives running ClickHouse-only sketch validation queries in DuckDB, the theta lg_k sweep operations referencing a DuckDB sketch type that does not exist, sketch storage-size bounds that no DuckDB sketch can satisfy, and PySpark Write Primitives failing to find the lineitem fixture for the aggregate-state sketch operation.

Fixed DataFrame Write Primitives and Metadata Primitives results reporting validation as not_run; they now validate the tables they load, and DataFrame TPC-Havoc variant ids now use the same 1_v1 form as SQL results so coverage of the 22 base queries is recognised; Polars TPC-Havoc Q15 variants no longer drop the top supplier to floating-point aggregation order.
